title: 90 Cheesy Pickup Lines for Him That Actually Get a Smile
h1: Cheesy Pickup Lines for Him: 90 Corny Lines That Actually Work
description: Make him laugh with 90 cheesy pickup lines for him: cute, punny, classy and text-ready, plus tips on delivery so the line opens a real conversation.
excerpt: Ninety corny, cute and gloriously punny pickup lines for him, sorted by vibe, plus how to deliver them so they start a real conversation.
intro:
A cheesy pickup line is basically a wink in sentence form. Nobody believes you think he's literally a magician or a parking ticket, and that's the point. The line tells him you're interested, you don't take yourself too seriously, and you're brave enough to go first. That combination is surprisingly attractive.

Below you'll find 90 cheesy pickup lines for him, grouped by mood: cute, punny, classy, nerdy and text-friendly. You'll also get a quick guide to delivery, because the same line can land as charming or awkward depending on how you say it. Pick a few favorites, make them your own, and go have some fun.
body:
Do cheesy pickup lines for him actually work?

They work, just not in the way most people expect. A corny line rarely makes someone fall for you on the spot. What it does well is break the ice. It gives him an easy, low-pressure reason to laugh, groan, or fire back a line of his own, and suddenly the two of you are talking.

The magic is in the shared joke. When you deliver a cheesy line with a grin that says I know this is ridiculous, you're inviting him to play along. Most guys rarely get approached first, so even a goofy opener tends to feel flattering. If he's interested, he'll pick up the thread. If he isn't, the playful tone makes it easy for both of you to laugh it off and move on.

Tip: The follow-up matters more than the line. Have a real question ready, like asking what brought him here tonight or what he's reading, so the laugh turns into an actual conversation.

Before you use a pickup line

You don't need a makeover to approach someone, but a few small things help you walk in feeling like yourself on a good day.

  • Wear something you feel great in. Comfort shows. If you're tugging at your outfit all night, that's where your attention goes instead of on him.
  • Keep it fresh. A clean scent and fresh breath are simple confidence boosters. Go light on perfume so it reads as pleasant rather than overpowering.
  • Practice out loud. Say your favorite lines to a friend or the mirror a couple of times. Lines sound much smoother once they've left your mouth before.
  • Read the room. If he's mid-conversation, on a call, or clearly having a rough day, wait for a better moment. Good timing is half the charm.

Cute and cheesy pickup lines for him

  1. Are you a magician? Every time I look at you, everyone else in the room disappears.
  2. Do you have a map? I keep getting lost in your eyes.
  3. I'm not a photographer, but I can definitely picture us together.
  4. Is your name Google? Because you have everything I've been searching for.
  5. Do you believe in love at first sight, or should I walk past you again?
  6. Are you a campfire? You're hot and I want s'more.
  7. If you were a vegetable, you'd be a cute-cumber.
  8. Is it hot in here, or is it just you?
  9. I must be a snowflake, because I've fallen for you.
  10. Are you made of copper and tellurium? Because you're Cu-Te.
  11. Can I follow you home? My parents always told me to follow my dreams.
  12. Do you have a Band-Aid? I scraped my knee falling for you.
  13. You must be tired, because you've been running through my mind all day.
  14. Is there an airport nearby, or is that just my heart taking off?
  15. Are you a bank loan? Because you have my interest.
  16. If kisses were snowflakes, I'd send you a blizzard.
  17. Your hand looks heavy. Can I hold it for you?
  18. Are you Wi-Fi? Because I'm feeling a connection.
  19. I was going to play it cool, but you're way too cute for that.
  20. Are you a star? Because your smile lights up the whole place.

Punny and adorably corny lines

Food puns are the cheesiest of the cheesy, which makes them perfect when you want a guaranteed eye-roll followed by a laugh.

  1. Are you a pizza? Because I want a pizza that.
  2. You're the cheese to my macaroni.
  3. Are you a donut? Because I donut know what I'd do without you.
  4. I'm feeling a little sugar-low. Mind if I borrow some of your sweetness?
  5. You must be a cup of coffee, because you're keeping me up at night.
  6. Are you a banana? Because I find you a-peeling.
  7. Are you a taco? Because I'd like to taco 'bout us.
  8. You're so sweet, you put Hershey's out of business.
  9. If you were a fruit, you'd be a fine-apple.
  10. Are you a pickle? Because you're kind of a big dill.
  11. I think you're bacon me crazy.
  12. Are you a cheeseburger? Because you're looking grate.
  13. We go together like peanut butter and jelly.
  14. Are you French toast? Because you've got me feeling all buttery inside.
  15. You're one in a melon.
  16. Are you a tea bag? Because you're steeping into my heart.
  17. Lettuce be together.
  18. I'm on a seafood diet. I see food, and right now I see you.
  19. Are you an avocado? Because you're the good kind of extra.
  20. Olive you already, and we just met.

Classy yet cheesy pickup lines for him

Want something a little smoother? These still carry a wink, but they lean romantic rather than slapstick.

  1. I was told to aim for the stars, and somehow I ended up standing next to you.
  2. If I could rearrange the alphabet, I'd put U and I together.
  3. I'd say God bless you, but it looks like he already did.
  4. You must be the reason the lights seem brighter in here.
  5. I didn't believe in fate until about five minutes ago.
  6. Is your name Chapter One? Because I'd love to see how this story goes.
  7. I don't usually do this, but you seem worth breaking a habit for.
  8. Something about you makes me want to skip the small talk.
  9. Are you a museum curator? Because you clearly have excellent taste, and you're a work of art.
  10. You look like someone who gives great directions. Could you point me toward your number?
  11. Of all the places I could be tonight, I'm glad I picked here.
  12. If you were a song, you'd be the one I keep on repeat.
  13. I'm usually great with words, but you've left me with very few.
  14. You have a smile I'd happily take credit for.
  15. Do you have a name, or can I call you mine?
  16. Are you the moon? Because even when it's dark, you're shining.
  17. I've been here for an hour, and you're the best view yet.
  18. Excuse me, I think you dropped something: my jaw.
  19. I'd like to take you somewhere nice. Maybe my future.
  20. I don't have a line. I just wanted to say hi to the most interesting person here.

Nerdy cheesy pickup lines for him

If he's a gamer, a science fan, or just loves a good fact, these will make him grin.

  1. Are you made of uranium? Because you're making my heart go critical.
  2. You must be the square root of negative one, because you can't be real.
  3. Are you a keyboard? Because you're just my type.
  4. I must be a light switch, because every time I see you, you turn me on.
  5. Are you a 90-degree angle? Because you look just right.
  6. Is your name Wi-Fi password? Because I need you to connect.
  7. You've just been added to my favorite players list.
  8. Do you like Star Wars? Because Yoda only one for me.
  9. Are you a black hole? Because I can't escape your pull.
  10. Our love is like pi: irrational and never-ending.
  11. If you were a triangle, you'd be acute one.
  12. Are you carbon? Because I want to date you.
  13. You're the player two I've been waiting for.
  14. Is your name Ctrl+S? Because I want to save this moment.
  15. I'd never put you on airplane mode.

Cheesy pickup lines for him over text

Texting gives you a second to hit send with confidence. These work especially well once you already have his number, or as a playful DM.

  1. I was going to text you something clever, but then I just thought about you instead.
  2. Are you my phone charger? Because without you, I'd die.
  3. My autocorrect keeps changing "hey" to "hey handsome." I don't know why. (I do.)
  4. I just checked, and my day is officially better since you texted.
  5. Do you have a sunburn, or are you always this hot?
  6. Quick survey: on a scale of 1 to America, how free are you this weekend?
  7. Is it weird that I'm smiling at my phone right now? Asking for me.
  8. My horoscope said I'd meet someone amazing. Thanks for proving it right.
  9. Roses are red, my screen is bright, I'd love to see you this Saturday night.
  10. Are you a notification? Because you always make me look.
  11. Good morning to everyone except the guy who keeps distracting me.
  12. Breaking news: local girl can't stop thinking about you.
  13. If you were a text, I'd never leave you on read.
  14. I'm writing a book on cute things. Can I interview you for the main chapter?
  15. Your name keeps popping up on my screen, and my heart keeps doing that skip thing.

For more ways to keep the chat flowing after the opener, see our guide on how to start a conversation with a guy over text.

How to use these cheesy pickup lines for him

  1. Own the cheese. Say it with a smile, maybe even a playful "Okay, I have to try this one on you." Self-aware delivery is what makes it charming.
  2. Match the line to the moment. Coffee puns at a cafe, nerdy lines at trivia night, classy ones at a wedding. Context makes a line feel spontaneous.
  3. Make eye contact and pause. Give him a second to react. Rushing past the punchline makes it seem like you're nervous about it.
  4. Bridge into a real question. After the laugh, ask about him. A line opens the door; curiosity keeps it open.
  5. Respect the answer. If he's polite but clearly not interested, smile, wish him a good night, and move on. That grace is attractive too, and it keeps the whole thing fun.
Tip: Pick one line per person and per night. Firing off three in a row turns a cute moment into a stand-up routine.

If he's into it, the next step is getting to know him. Our list of questions to ask a guy to get to know him picks up right where the pickup line leaves off, and these tips on how to get a guy to like you cover what to do beyond the first hello.

The bottom line on being cheesy

The best cheesy pickup lines for him aren't really about the words. They're about showing up with warmth, humor, and a little courage. Choose lines that feel like you, deliver them with a grin, and let them lead into genuine conversation. Want even more options? Browse our full collection of pickup lines, including sweet pick up lines for when you want to swap the cheese for something softer.
takeaways: Cheesy lines work as icebreakers, not magic spells: their job is to start a conversation.
Deliver them with a self-aware smile so he knows you're in on the joke.
Match the line to the setting and follow up with a real question about him.
Use one line at a time and respect his response either way.

faq.q: What is the cheesiest pickup line for a guy?
faq.a: Food puns tend to win the cheesiness contest. Lines like "Are you a pizza? Because I want a pizza that" or "You're one in a melon" are so corny that they almost always get a laugh or an eye-roll, which is exactly the reaction you want to break the ice.

faq.q: Do guys like it when girls use pickup lines?
faq.a: Many guys find it flattering because they're rarely approached first. A playful, lighthearted line signals confidence and interest without pressure. As with anyone, it depends on the person and the moment, so read his reaction and keep things friendly and respectful.

faq.q: Should I use a cheesy pickup line over text?
faq.a: Yes, texting is a great place for cheesy lines because the tone is already casual and he can respond in his own time. Add an emoji or a follow-up like "sorry, I had to" to show you're being playful, then steer toward a real question.

faq.q: What should I say after a pickup line?
faq.a: Follow the laugh with something genuine: introduce yourself, comment on your shared setting, or ask a question about him, such as what he's drinking, reading or doing this weekend. The pickup line opens the door, but curiosity is what keeps the conversation going.
